metadata.description: Official Octen plugin for real-time web search, research, and URL extraction.

plugins.name: octen
plugins.description: Real-time web search, news with storyline clustering, company and person profiles, local place lookup, fast destination lookup, broad multi-angle research, URL extraction and image search through Octen's hosted MCP server, plus video search in invite-only Beta. Authorizes over OAuth on first use — nothing to install and no API key to paste.
